en-US.title: HabitBuster
en-US.description:
Break the habit. Notice the moment.

HabitBuster works with a compatible FaceDefense wrist-worn Bluetooth sensor to help you notice repetitive hand movements. Connect the sensor, calibrate a behavior using your own motion, and follow detections in the app.

Features:
• Calibrate and save behavior profiles for movements you want to monitor
• View live motion readings, wrist position, and recent detections
• Start, pause, or use silent tracking with alerts muted
• See today's detected touch count, weekly totals, and your day streak
• Choose optional alerts, including sounds and phone notifications

A compatible FaceDefense sensor is required for calibration and live tracking. Keep the app open and the sensor connected while monitoring. Motion detection can miss or misclassify movements. HabitBuster is a self-awareness tool and is not a medical device.
en-US.promoText: Pair HabitBuster with a FaceDefense wristband to calibrate a motion pattern, track detected touches, and follow daily progress with optional alerts.
